He carries himself with a calm, gentle presence and has that rare “on/off switch” happy to join you for an adventure, but just as content to melt into you for hours. His favorite place in the world? Curled up as close as possible, quietly soaking in your love. He’s incredibly smart and thrives with guidance, structure, and someone patient enough to keep building on everything he’s learned. Bane is the kind of dog who wants to get it right, he just needs a person who understands him and is willing to continue that journey with him. Out in the world, he’s neutral, well-mannered, and gentle with both people and dogs. He gets along beautifully with his pack, especially enjoying playtime with his female friends. Bane will do best in an experienced home, ideally with someone familiar with Dobermans or working breeds, who understands the importance of consistency and routine. He bonds deeply with his person and will thrive in a home that embraces that connection while continuing to build his confidence and independence. No cats or small animals unless fully separated. No small children. In the right home, Bane is everything people dream of in a Doberman, loyal, intuitive, affectionate, and endlessly devoted. He’s not just looking for a home… he’s looking for his person. 🖤 If you’re interested in adopting Bane, please fill out an application through @StacyHopeRescue Please be patient as we review applications, we are never in a rush.
